$schema: Template block schemas for Figma design system generation. Each template defines structure, style assignments, and spacing. All values reference config paths — no hardcoded pixel values except where noted.

header.description: Reusable header block. SM variant for sections, LG variant for frame titles. Optional divider (composes standalone divider component).

showDescription.$note: Hides description text AND collapses its spacing. Never leave description empty — toggle this off instead.

interactive-preview.description: Elevated container for interactive component testing. Contains a 'Try Me!' button and a component instance. Padding is hardcoded — specific to preview layout needs, not a design system spacing decision.

container.$exception: Preview padding is hardcoded — specific to preview layout needs, not a design system spacing decision. Bottom padding includes 44px clearance for the absolute-positioned Try Me button.

try-me-button.$note: Monochrome on purpose — it is chrome around a specimen, not a specimen. Absolutely positioned bottom-right of interactive preview.
try-me-button.label: figma.layout.typography.defaults.try-me-label

alert-banner.description: Status-colored notice banner with contextual icon. Container fill + primary border + on-container text and icon color.
alert-banner.$icon-rule: Icon color matches text-color. Icons inherit the text color of their parent context unless specifically overridden.

divider.description: Horizontal separator line. Composed into header when divider toggle is true.

variant-section.description: A labeled group of component variant instances.

swatch-block.description: Color swatch with info row. Defined in config/figma/color-palette.json.
